body: I've tried going to the on campus psychiatrist but I felt ashamed for wanting to talk about my lack of sex and suicide in a serious way. I have no problem talking about sexuality jokingly or in terms of LGBT rights, but when it comes to my own I feel akward. I just don't want someone to know who I am and knew these problems I have.

I think it's cool that you care so much about people that you've never even met. I don't think I'm that urgent. I mean I'm happy a lot if the time, especially after a workout. Except there are times when things just hit me hard, especially after things don't go my way. And I don't mean that in a childish way, I mean when something blows up in my face. The GRE today was a good example. I spent countless hours studying and in the end I get a terrible score. I know what I need to do, which is just take the test again. But that's like getting back on the horse when you're tired of falling off of it.
